request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Designed for agentic systems and coding/professional/research workflows: carrying out complex, multi-step, long-horizon agentic tasks, with broader support for popular harnesses and development tools so it integrates into existing stacks. Text-only model (thinking mode required), served via inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed) or APIs.
quotes: Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks. Beyond answering harder questions, Qwen3.8 is designed to carry complex, multi-step tasks through to completion with greater reliability.
**Downstream Compatibility**: Broader support for popular harnesses and development tools, making it easier to integrate into your existing stack.
Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B is a text-only model that requires thinking mode for all interactions.
These artifacts are compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed, etc.
